prompt: help me plan my weekend trip to yosemite
response: For a weekend trip to Yosemite, arrive on a Friday to make the most of your time. Spend Saturday exploring the park's natural wonders, like Yosemite Falls and Half Dome, and try to secure a campsite in advance if you plan to stay overnight. Enjoy a leisurely Sunday with a picnic and some easy hiking trails. Make sure to check the park's website for any fire restrictions or road closures before you go.
